record.field: Restricted Sales Representative
Restricts selected sales representatives to customers assigned to them through the customer Salesperson field, plus those customers' sales orders, invoices, and statement lines.
Sales Representative

Same restrictions as Restricted Sales Representative - only the customers assigned to them through the customer Salesperson field, plus those customers' sales orders, invoices and statement lines - but this level may also create sales orders, and read and edit the orders it created.
